components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pulse-gradient CTA with animated sweep and compositor-only hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #ffffff; border: none; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #FB7502 0%, #FF6A07 100%); background-size: 200% 200%; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(255, 107, 7, 0.5); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(255, 107, 7, 0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #FF6B07; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Bento Tile — Light
components.description: Flat, opaque hero/marketing tile. No shadow, no blur — depth comes from color contrast against neighboring tiles.
components.html:
Novo módulo

Domine edição de vídeo
components.css: .ds-bento-light { background: #F5F7F8; color: #1D1E1F; border-radius: 40px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-bento-light h3 { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0; } .ds-bento-label { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: color-mix(in oklab, #1D1E1F 60%, transparent); }

components.name: Bento Tile — Dark
components.description: Flat, opaque dark tile — the near-black counterpart in the four-fill bento rotation.

components.description: The single accent-fill tile per composition, per the Rare Orange Rule.

components.name: Pill Bar
components.description: Full-radius stat/label bar used inside bento hero collages and as filter/status chips elsewhere.
components.css: .ds-pill-bar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FF6B07; color: #ffffff; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Translucent overlay surface, scoped to modals, sticky headers, banners, and one featured card at a time. Not the default content card anymore.
components.html:
Aviso importante

Este é um exemplo de card translúcido.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: color-mix(in oklab, #FEFEFE 62%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(140%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, white 55%, transparent); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px -12px rgba(29, 30, 31, 0.3); padding: 24px; color: #1D1E1F; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-glass-card h4 { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-glass-card p { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; } .ds-glass-card:hover, .ds-glass-card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 48px -16px rgba(29, 30, 31, 0.4); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field default under the new md radius scale — up from the prior implicit browser default.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #FEFEFE; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, #1D1E1F 12%, transparent); color: #1D1E1F; font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, #1D1E1F 55%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #FF6B07; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, #FF6B07 35%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Pullse is a paid video-course platform organized around a single motif: the pulse waveline as a live, energetic signal. The system has two layers now. The established layer — one orange accent used sparingly, Lexend as the sole type family carrying hierarchy through scale rather than weight soup, and glassmorphism as a rare, purposeful overlay treatment — stays intact and unchanged from the original implementation. The new layer, sourced from the new-design/ Figma exports, introduces an oversized-radius bento grid: flat, opaque, high-contrast tiles (light surface, near-black ink, pulse orange, and photo/screenshot fills) tiled edge-to-edge with generous gutters, each corner rounded far beyond the system's original 1rem default. This is the platform's new rounded style for hero, marketing, and showcase surfaces. The two layers are deliberately kept apart, not merged: bento tiles are solid and shadow-free; glass stays translucent and blurred but is now scoped strictly to true overlays.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (#FF6B07), used rarely — CTAs, active state, at most one bento tile per composition.
Oversized corner radius is now the platform's signature shape language: nothing sharper than 12px, hero bento tiles at 40px.
Bento tiles are flat and opaque — depth comes from color contrast and gutter spacing, never blur or shadow.
Glass is demoted to overlay-only duty: it no longer competes with bento tiles as a general card treatment.
The dark accent-ink canvas (#582807) is new vocabulary, reserved for hero/marketing sections — the admin and aluno app shell stays on the light surface background.
Lexend, one family, multiple weights — no second typeface introduced by the new direction.

rules.name: The Rare Orange Rule
rules.body: The accent carries ≤10-15% of any given screen, bento grids included. One accent-fill tile per composition, not a repeating pattern.

rules.name: The Canvas Split Rule
rules.body: --color-accent-ink as a full-bleed page background is hero/marketing territory only. Admin and aluno surfaces stay on --color-surface.

rules.name: The Scale-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built through size and weight steps within one family, never a second typeface.

rules.name: The Flat Bento Rule
rules.body: Bento tiles never receive box-shadow or backdrop-filter. If a surface needs elevation, it isn't a bento tile — it's a glass overlay.

dos: Do build hero, marketing, and showcase surfaces as bento grids: xl-radius (40px), flat, opaque tiles in exactly four fills (light / dark / accent / photo), 24px gutter.
Do reserve the dark accent-ink (#582807) canvas for hero/marketing sections and bento showcases; keep admin and aluno app-shell screens on --color-surface.
Do keep glass (.glass / .glass-strong / .glass-accent) for true overlays only — modals, sticky headers, banners, one featured card at a time.
Do use the full radius scale by role: sm 12px (inputs baseline, chips), md 20px (buttons, inputs, small cards), lg 28px (glass overlay cards), xl 40px (bento tiles), full (pills, tags, avatars).
Do keep motion compositor-only (transform, opacity, filter, clip-path) with expo ease-out and a reduced-motion alternative for every animation.
Do cap the accent orange at ≤10-15% of any screen, bento grids included.
donts: Don't apply backdrop-filter or translucency to bento tiles — they are flat and opaque; blur is an overlay-only signal now.
Don't let the dark accent-ink canvas bleed into /admin/* or /aluno/* — those stay light for extended sessions.
Don't use more than one accent-orange bento tile per composition — the Rare Orange Rule holds inside the bento grid too.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't clip a gradient to text (background-clip: text) outside the existing .text-gradient utility's narrow, single-hero-word use — never body copy.
Don't ship anything below the sm radius (12px) in new work — the old sharp-cornered default is retired.
